[!isolates] skip
# Support functions contribute their own state and initialize shared deps once.
[short] skip
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o host.exe ./host
exec ./host.exe
stdout 'support state independent'
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -race -o race.exe ./host
exec ./race.exe
stdout 'support state independent'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatesupport

go 1.26
-- shared/v1.2.0/shared.go --
package shared
var Counter int
func init() { Counter++ }
-- support/v1.2.0/support.go --
package support
import "example.org/isolatesupport/shared/v1.2.0"
var Count = 10
// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Factory() (int,error) { Count++; shared.Counter++; return Count+shared.Counter,nil }
-- entry/entry.go --
package entry
import "example.org/isolatesupport/shared/v1.2.0"
var Count = 1
// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Work(input int) (int,error) { Count++; shared.Counter++; return input+Count+shared.Counter,nil }
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "time"
 "example.org/isolatesupport/entry"
 "example.org/isolatesupport/support/v1.2.0"
 "example.org/isolatesupport/shared/v1.2.0"
)
func main() {
 h,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(entry.Work); if !ok { panic("missing work") }
 factory,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(support.Factory); if !ok { panic("missing factory") }
 if instance,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:h.ProgramWithSupport(isolate.Handle{},func(isolate.Handle,isolate.Handle){})}); err==nil || instance!=nil { panic("empty support accepted") }
 if instance,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:h.ProgramWithSupports([]isolate.Handle{{}},func(isolate.Handle,[]isolate.Handle){})}); err==nil || instance!=nil { panic("empty supports accepted") }
 for pass:=0;pass<6;pass++ {
  p:=h.ProgramWithSupport(factory,dispatch)
  if pass>=3 {
   supports:=[]isolate.Handle{factory,factory,h}
   p=h.ProgramWithSupports(supports,func(h isolate.Handle,private []isolate.Handle){
    if len(private)!=3 || private[0].Name()!=private[1].Name() || private[2].Name()!=h.Name() { panic("support order or snapshot changed") }
    private[0]=isolate.Handle{} // The dispatcher receives writable private storage.
    dispatch(h,private[1])
   })
   supports[0]=isolate.Handle{} // Caller mutation must not change the program.
  }
  i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:p}); if err!=nil { panic(err) }
  if err=i.Start(); err!=nil { panic(err) }
  select { case command:=<-i.Commands(): command.Reply(nil,nil); case <-i.Done(): panic(i.Wait()) }
  if err=i.Wait(); err!=nil { panic(err) }
  ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),time.Second); err=i.Kill(ctx); cancel(); if err!=nil { panic(err) }
 }
 if entry.Count!=1 || support.Count!=10 || shared.Counter!=1 { panic("host state changed") }
 fmt.Println("support state independent")
}
func dispatch(h,f isolate.Handle){
   var input int
   err:=f.Invoke(func(args ...isolate.Value)error{return nil},func(values ...isolate.Value)error{ input=values[0].Value.(int); return nil })
   if err!=nil { panic(err) }
   err=h.Invoke(func(args ...isolate.Value)error{ *args[0].Pointer.(*int)=input; return nil },func(values ...isolate.Value)error{
    if values[0].Value.(int)!=18 { panic("support or shared state leaked") }
    _,err:=isolate.Call(1,nil); return err
   }); if err!=nil { panic(err) }
  }
